body.statement: The fully serialized record \(\mathsf F_\star\) satisfies \(\mathsf F_\star.I\in\mathfrak I_{2,71}^{\ge3}\). Its listed observational table has \(64\) strictly positive rational cells; its listed raw matrices split into factors of sizes \(2,2,2,2\) and \(16,16\) in each later block; its one-bag decomposition covers every equality and each of its \(4096\) cubic monomial scopes; and exact replay of the two listed response-mass vectors verifies all raw equalities, nonnegativity, unit root masses, and reconstruction of the same table. Complete support replay returns factor-vertex counts \(80\) and \(32\) in each later block, \(243\) projected tuples, and the sharp values \(g_\star(z^{\star,0})=11/64\) and \(g_\star(z^{\star,1})=53/64\). Thus the endpoint masses may contain zeros while every observational cell remains positive.
body.justification: A complete cubic fixture is the direct sanity check on sharpness, zero endpoint masses, the source kernel, the decomposition, and certificate replay.
body.gap: Recent sharp dynamic-regime recursion covers a rectangular transition model, while this witness tests a canonical response program with disconnected equality factors and no rectangularity assumption supplied externally.
body.consumer: The record is a positive conformance fixture for the generator, verifier, and deliberate certificate-corruption tests.
